title: JaredH4 Skyblock
description: Modpack designed for Hypixel Skyblock with QOL tweaks and misc skyblock mods
body:
This Modpack was made by JaredH4 as a Hypixel Skyblock focused Modpack. With performance mods, many skyblock mods, and both QOL and visual mods.
